hero.description: Padora stands as a symbol of style, luxury and sophistication — renowned for exquisite leather creations, Arabian and French-inspired perfumes, and elegant fashion wear.

brand.title: A Legacy Of Style For Today's Individual
brand.p1: Inspired by the journey of modern elegance and traditional craftsmanship, Padora bridges heritage with contemporary sophistication. Born from the fusion of comfort and craftsmanship, Padora embodies elegance, confidence and intelligent living.
brand.p2: Every step with Padora reflects the harmony between comfort and grace, in an experience that defines modern refinement. Since its inception, the brand has remained committed to timeless design, superior quality and meticulous attention to detail — managed by mnma, upholding a promise of sophistication and luxury through refined design, flawless quality and timeless elegance.

genuineLeather.title: Genuine Leather
genuineLeather.desc: Crafted from authentic leather, offering timeless style and enduring comfort — whether for your feet or your look.

parfum.title: Parfum & Fragrance
parfum.desc: Expertly blended with authentic Arabian and French essences, creating a signature scent that leaves a lasting impression.

wearFashion.title: Wear Fashion
wearFashion.desc: Meticulously designed with exceptional craftsmanship, offering elegance that transcends fleeting trends.

authenticity.title: Trusted Authenticity
authenticity.desc: Every Padora creation is authentic, clearly described and marketed honestly — backed by fair return policies and quality you can trust.

cta.title: Padora — The Symbol Of Timeless Class
cta.description: Discover leather, fragrance and fashion crafted with meticulous attention to detail, offering a statement of distinction for those who value refined taste and enduring elegance.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy & Delivery Time
shipping.coverage: We deliver across the UAE and all GCC countries.

times.title: Delivery Times
times.uae: UAE: 1–3 working days (delivery time may vary during peak seasons or holidays).
times.gcc: GCC & International: 5–10 working days, depending on destination and shipping service.

shipping.freeShipping: Free delivery may be available on selected orders across the UAE as per ongoing offers or promotions. GCC and international shipping charges apply based on destination and selected shipping service.

tracking.title: Order Tracking
tracking.desc: Tracking details will be provided after the order has been dispatched.

responsibility.title: Delivery Responsibility
responsibility.desc: Padora shall be responsible for any delays or damages occurring during delivery or caused by the courier service.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.item1: Orders can be cancelled only before dispatch.
cancellation.item2: Once shipped, orders cannot be cancelled.
cancellation.refundInfo: Refunds for eligible cancellations are processed within 7 working days.

brand.title: Brand Policy Description
brand.item4: Supported by fair return / refund terms.
brand.item6: Respectful of local culture and consumer protection laws.

contact.title: Contact Us

hero.title: Delivery & Returns Policy
hero.subtitle: Complete guidance on shipping schedules, tracking, returns, exchange rules, and cancellation SLAs.

times.title: Estimated Delivery Timelines
times.uaeDesc: 1–3 Working Days. Express options available at checkout.
times.gccDesc: 5–10 Working Days depending on local customs processing.

freeShipping.title: Free Standard Delivery
freeShipping.desc: Enjoy complimentary delivery on qualified UAE orders during store promotions. GCC rates apply based on parcel weight and destination.

tracking.title: Real-Time Tracking
tracking.desc: Once dispatched, tracking links are sent via email/SMS and updated in your profile dashboard.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges Policy
returns.intro: We want you to love every Padora purchase. If you are not completely satisfied, we offer straightforward returns and exchanges within our policy terms.

window.title: Return Window
window.desc: Return or exchange requests must be initiated within 7 to 14 days of order delivery.

eligibility.title: Eligibility Requirements
eligibility.item1: Items must be unused, unwashed, and in original brand packaging.
eligibility.item2: All original labels, security tags, and authenticity certificates must be attached.
eligibility.item3: Proof of purchase (invoice or order ID) is required.

nonReturnable.title: Non-Returnable Items
nonReturnable.item2: Opened or unsealed fragrances and hygiene-sensitive items (unless defective).

process.title: How to Return an Item
process.step1: Contact support via email or WhatsApp with your Order ID and reason.
process.step2: Our logistics team schedules a courier pickup at your preferred address.
process.step3: Once inspected and approved, your refund or exchange is processed promptly.

beforeDispatch.title: Before Dispatch
beforeDispatch.desc: 100% full refund available if cancelled before dispatch.

afterDispatch.title: After Dispatch
afterDispatch.desc: Shipped orders cannot be cancelled mid-transit. Return terms apply once received.

customOrders.title: Custom Orders
customOrders.desc: Personalized products cannot be cancelled once production has started.

refundSla.title: Refund SLA
refundSla.desc: Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 7 working days.

responsibility.title: Courier & Delivery Responsibility
responsibility.desc: Padora takes full responsibility for any package loss or damage occurring during delivery by our courier partners. If your order arrives damaged, contact us within 48 hours for immediate replacement.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I check my order shipping status?
faq.a1: Log into your account and navigate to Profile > Orders to view real-time tracking numbers and courier updates.
faq.q2: What should I do if my package arrives damaged?
faq.a2: Take photos of the box and product, then email support@padoraonline.com or message us on WhatsApp immediately. We will arrange a replacement at no extra cost.
faq.a3: Standard shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to a damaged or incorrect item sent by Padora.

contact.title: Need Help With Delivery or Returns?
contact.desc: Our dedicated support team is ready to assist you every day from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM GST.
